narrative.overview:
Relay is an Operate product: reviewed company context becomes a bounded representative and campaign, and each customer attempt becomes an attributable conversation, commitment, or proposed improvement. The interface gives the operator one clear place and next action while preserving the records underneath. DM Sans, cool white and lilac-gray surfaces, indigo emphasis, restrained status color, and Lucide icons remain the visual identity; the workflow extensions change composition, not the brand world.

Overview adds a flat Campaigns in progress list that keeps campaign identity, goal, offering, exact phase, and next action together. Continuing an active run or saved campaign phase takes priority over optional channel setup. Agents uses one shared release-review pattern in Publish and release history: Candidate, Active now, and Decision remain visible while a fresh server packet separates configuration proof, required text proof, and explicitly unproven voice/device evidence. Publication stays explicit and the channel handoff stays separate.

Live and saved call surfaces present client timing as independent browser-event intervals with Samples, Latest, P50, and P95 per stage. P50 requires 3 samples, P95 requires 20, and each stage retains at most 20. Unknown values remain an em dash, measured zero remains 0 ms, and typed calls name microphone-only evidence as not observed rather than zero. The rows are never added into an end-to-end latency figure. The finish review in docs/duplex-finish-review-oct09.md returned SHIP for this scoped increment after the nine duplex-{release,home,timing}-{desktop,mobile,user674}.png captures. Its focused suite passed 39/39, and the final frozen source separately passed 804/804 root terminal tests. After one unused test-only @ts-expect-error annotation was removed, the corrected terminal production build completed with exit 0, including TypeScript and the postbuild package check across 1,104 entries; runtime and UI behavior were unchanged. The release decision bar and rollback candidate were source- and test-reviewed but not visually captured. This is interface evidence only, not an auditory, acoustic/end-to-end latency, microphone/device, hosted-channel, external-delivery, competitor, or whole-product claim.

Voice Studio now offers Live understanding as a default-off, explicitly consented Azure microphone-call option. The call freezes that choice. Its dedicated inspector replaces temporary current words on each revision, keeps them out of the transcript, and labels language, pace, and pause-request cues as tentative communication guidance rather than emotion truth. Ready, off, connecting, unavailable, paused, and ended states remain visible; mute, end, native final, and failure clear temporary words and cues, while recognition counts remain metadata only. The scoped finish review in docs/continuous-speech-finish-review-oct09.md returned SHIP for four captures, with filled-speech and error lifecycle behavior bounded to source and tests. The record reports 39/39 focused checks, 900/900 root tests, standalone typecheck, a Next 16.4 build and 1,113-entry package check, plus app, gateway, and worklet HTTP 200. One isolated synthetic-audio Azure SDK server probe produced four interims and one sidecar final; no browser microphone call was run. This is not recognition-accuracy, physical-device, perceptual-voice, latency, full-duplex, hosted, competitor, or whole-product evidence. No new imagery or motion obligation follows.

Campaign agent preparation now carries one exact saved campaign revision into Agents, binds only one exact active release, and returns to the same campaign Review for current eligibility. Usage & services separates UTC allowances, occupied connection slots, attempt state, heartbeat freshness, and saved queues without presenting charges or service outcomes. Quality Audio proof freezes one fictional fixture and immutable version, retains every attempt, separates captured output and transcript from browser playback, and requires explicit human attestations for listening reviews. The 10 October scoped UI verdict was SHIP after eight original captures, corrected desktop/mobile Usage recaptures, and a supplemental mobile slot capture. The frozen source passed 983/983 tests and a Next 16.4 build with TypeScript and the 1,179-entry package check. One 6.9375-second fixture retained a failed first attempt and then produced 9.7 seconds of captured AI output from the same bytes with browser playback completed; no human listening verdict was supplied. A separate 29-second, three-turn private Azure Listen & type call ended through the UI, confirmed provider hangup, and saved its preview. These are bounded workflow and artifact results, not physical-microphone, human-listening, perceptual-quality, full-duplex, hosted, competitor, billing, or whole-product evidence. No new imagery or motion obligation follows.

Voice & language now carries an optional Azure-only v1 speech-delivery profile for workspace default, Standard 1×, Unhurried 0.9×, and finite explicit final caller requests. Teacher voice auditions expose Taxila-source Diya and Arjun as consented private seven-day Azure Speech samples without changing the agent or live voice. Quality listening comparisons reuse server-matched stored recordings, keep a stable masked A/B order, require complete-listening attestation, and reveal only after append-only Naturalness, Pacing, Clarity, and Professional warmth ratings. The scoped review in docs/speech-delivery-finish-review-oct10.md returned SHIP after the final 1280×900 and 390×844 capture set, including a verified 2×2 mobile Quality tab grid with 44px targets. Frozen source passed 1,054/1,054 tests, TypeScript, the Next 16.4 build, the 1,207-entry package check, and packaged readiness HTTP 200. Matched artifacts A and B reported finite 14.0805-second and 16.75-second durations at media ready state 4 before playback; the saved pair remains 0/4 ratings with no reveal, attestation, or human preference. A separate post-fix private call closure is operational evidence only. This does not establish a perceptual win, pronunciation quality, preferred speed, live Taxila migration, publication approval, provider superiority, hosted readiness, or whole-product quality. No new imagery or motion obligation follows.

rules.name: The State Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Use indigo, green, rose, and small motion to explain location, action, or record state. Do not introduce color as a quality claim.

rules.name: The Record Readability Rule
rules.body: Keep working copy and controls at 13–14px; reserve 10–12px type for supporting metadata, never for a required decision or action.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Keep containers flat at rest. Use a border, wash, or one small transient shadow to establish hierarchy; never use elevation to imply confidence or model quality.

dos: Do organize new destinations under Overview, Company, Agents, Campaigns, Activity, or Settings and preserve a clear owner for every saved artifact.
Do keep inactive navigation groups collapsed while retaining direct links, search, aliases, and anchors for all former destinations.
Do derive Overview from saved company readiness and current records, and present one next action with its evidence.
Do prefer active campaign work over optional channel setup and treat only the latest unresolved exact-version failure as attention.
Do keep the agent picker compact, editor spacious, tester continuously mounted, and Save draft / Test agent available from the toolbar.
Do preserve raw editing buffers, focus the first invalid field, and guard all route and history exits when the draft is dirty.
Do run checks against an exact saved version, publish explicitly, then pass the active release into a separate Channel draft.
Do keep candidate, active version, exact server review, configuration proof, required text proof, and unproven voice/device evidence distinct throughout release and rollback decisions.
Do show timing intervals independently with sample counts, minimums of 3 for P50 and 20 for P95, a 20-sample cap, and unknown or typed-microphone-absent states that never masquerade as zero.
Do keep Live understanding default off, Azure microphone-only, explicitly consented, frozen per call, and visibly separate from the transcript and native final-turn authority.
Do replace temporary current words per revision, clear words and cues on mute, end, final, or failure, and treat recognition counts as metadata only.
Do keep Intent, Audience, Agent & content, Review, Run, and Results on one durable campaign ID with partial saves and exact revision checks.
Do carry campaign context into the existing agent workspace, bind only an exact active release, and return to the same campaign Review for current eligibility.
Do keep AI suggestions and proposals as attributable receipts until an operator explicitly uses or applies them, and invalidate stale readiness when authority changes.
Do keep customer intake resumable per actor, preserve exact source evidence, reconcile whole-source counts, and separate prepared decisions from atomic Apply.
Do keep source-wide exclusions, exception filters, saved revision conflicts, timeouts, and uncertain apply outcomes visible with direct recovery actions.
Do preserve imported customer fields through the canonical handoff while keeping source do-not-contact restrictions and channel permission separate.
Do build Text rehearsal from a reviewed redacted checkpoint, generate a new reply from one exact agent version, preserve failed attempts, and require explicit operator verdicts over exact quotes.
Do bind required-suite truth to the latest attempt, current case set, runtime/configuration, knowledge authority, and blocking reviews while keeping older attempts inspectable.
Do keep allowance reservations, occupied connection slots, provider-reported usage, service heartbeats, and saved queue counts as separate operational evidence.
Do bind Audio proof to one immutable version and exact fixture bytes, retain failed attempts, and keep playback events, transcripts, and human listening reviews separate.
Do keep speech-delivery choices versioned, Azure-only, finite, and separate from response length, inferred emotion, and perceptual claims.
Do keep teacher auditions consented, private, expiring, provider-separated, and visibly independent from the agent draft and live Realtime voice.
Do match comparison inputs on the server, mask A/B until four append-only ratings, and preserve No preference, Neither works, and written reasons.
Do keep Results separate from Run and distinguish provider acceptance, reviewed evidence, and business outcome.
Do preserve role limits, consent controls, explicit AI identity, anonymous/unverified participant labels, and human-review boundaries.
donts: Don't restore the former 18 peer destinations or a three-column agent workbench.
Don't treat all historical failed checks as open attention or let an optional deployment displace running campaign work.
Don't repeat prompt fields across sections, unmount the tester during section changes, or hide the artifact targeted by Save, Test, Publish, or Channel setup.
Don't let a draft test, configuration check, release, or prefilled Channel draft imply public activation, live delivery, voice quality, identity verification, or business value.
Don't add independent client timing rows into a synthetic latency total or treat browser-event timing as audible, acoustic, or end-to-end evidence.
Don't treat tentative words or communication cues as a saved transcript, emotion truth, confidence score, recognition-quality result, or permission for the agent to reply.
Don't bypass the dirty guard for Back, Forward, hash links, search, agent switching, or contextual navigation.
Don't turn a phase change, partial save, AI suggestion, content proposal, preflight, or provider receipt into implied approval, launch, delivery, or success.
Don't let campaign-to-agent navigation bind a draft, unpublished version, stale release, or different campaign, or bypass the return-to-Review check.
Don't let AI mapping, bulk preparation, a saved intake review, or a source handoff silently change customers, grant contact permission, or clear an imported restriction.
Don't hide skipped, excluded, blocked, pending, stale, or historically failed evidence behind a completed batch or passing latest result.
Don't treat a Text rehearsal judgment or passing required suite as publication approval, a Realtime/audio benchmark, a live-channel result, or a production claim.
Don't present allowances as invoices, reserved duration as measured billing, occupied slots as completed or live calls, or a heartbeat as service success.
Don't treat synthetic fixture playback, a browser playback event, recognized text, or an unreviewed AI output as human listening, microphone, perceptual-quality, full-duplex, or competitor evidence.
Don't translate `0.9×`, an exact provider acknowledgement, output duration, or an explicit pace request into proof of perceived slowness, warmth, naturalness, or improvement.
Don't present a Diya/Arjun audition as teacher identity, pronunciation validation, the agent's live voice, or a full Taxila migration.
Don't reveal comparison sources before all four ratings, overwrite a saved assessment, infer correctness from preference, or let a pair auto-select or publish a version.
Don't duplicate the execution workbench in Results, hide empty result-field states, or collapse recipient evidence into campaign-level claims.
Don't present a focused review verdict as whole-product usability, production, hosted-channel, voice-quality, billing, or competitor-superiority evidence.
